marketType.name: 1X2 - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home team), X (draw), or 2 (away team). Result is based on regular playing time only - Overtime does not count.

marketType.name: 1X2 1UP - FT
marketType.explainer: 1UP means that if your team goes a goal ahead at any point before Full Time, we'll pay you early. Draw is settled at full-time as usual.

marketType.name: 1X2 2UP - FT
marketType.explainer: 2UP means that if your team goes 2 goals ahead at any point before Full Time, we'll pay you early. Draw is settled at full-time as usual.

marketType.name: Double Chance - FT
marketType.explainer: One bet covering two results: 1X (home win or draw), X2 (draw or away win) or 12 (home or away win). Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Double Chance 1UP - FT
marketType.explainer: 1UP means that if a team in your selection goes a goal ahead at any point before Full Time, we'll pay you early.

marketType.name: Both Teams To Score - FT
marketType.displayName: Both Teams To Score | Full Time
marketType.explainer: Will both teams score at least one goal? Pick Yes or No. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Goal
marketType.explainer: Pick which team scores the next goal. The goal number is shown in brackets.

marketType.name: Total Score Over/Under - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick how many goals will be scored during the stated period. Over is more than that amount, Under is less.

marketType.name: Total Score Over/Under - FT - Home Team
marketType.explainer: Pick how many goals will be scored by home team during the stated period. Over is more than that amount, Under is less.

marketType.name: Total Score Over/Under - FT - Away Team
marketType.explainer: Pick how many goals will be scored by away team during the stated period. Over is more than that amount, Under is less.

marketType.name: HT / FT
marketType.explainer: Pick the result at half time and at the end of the match. For example, 1/X means the home team leads at half time and the match ends level. Based on Normal time only.

marketType.name: Handicap 1X2 - FT
marketType.explainer: The handicap you pick is added to or taken off that team's score before the bet is settled. Pick 1 (home team), X (level) or 2 (away team) on the adjusted score. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: 1X2 - 1H
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home team), X (draw), or 2 (away team). Only the score in the first half counts.

marketType.name: 1X2 - 2H
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home team), X (draw), or 2 (away team). Only the score in the second half counts.

marketType.name: 1X2 - from 1 to 10 minutes
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home team), X (draw), or 2 (away team). Only goals scored between 00:01 and 09:59 on the match clock count.

marketType.name: Total Score Over/Under - 1H
marketType.explainer: Pick how many goals will be scored during the stated period. Over is more than that amount, Under is less.

marketType.name: Total Score Over/Under - 2H
marketType.explainer: Pick how many goals will be scored during the stated period. Over is more than that amount, Under is less.

marketType.name: Handicap 1X2 - 1H
marketType.explainer: The handicap you pick is added to or taken off that team's score before the bet is settled. Pick 1 (home team), X (level) or 2 (away team) on the adjusted score. Only the first half score counts.

marketType.name: Handicap 1X2 - 2H
marketType.explainer: The handicap you pick is added to or taken off that team's score before the bet is settled. Pick 1 (home team), X (level) or 2 (away team) on the adjusted score. Only the second half score counts.

marketType.name: Asian Handicap - FT
marketType.explainer: The handicap you pick is added to or taken off that team's score before the bet is settled. Pick 1 (home team) or 2 (away team) to be ahead on the adjusted score. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Half More Goals - Total
marketType.explainer: Pick which half has more goals in total: 'First Half', 'Second Half' or 'Equal'.

marketType.name: 1X2 and Totals - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick the match result and whether total goals are over or under the number shown. Both parts must be right for the bet to win. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Draw No Bet - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home team) or 2 (away team) to win. If the match ends level, you get your stake back. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Draw No Bet - 1H
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home team) or 2 (away team) to win the first half. If the half ends level, you get your stake back. Only the first half score counts.

marketType.name: Draw No Bet - 2H
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home team) or 2 (away team) to win the second half. If the half ends level, you get your stake back. Only the second half score counts.

marketType.name: Correct Score (26 Outcomes)
marketType.explainer: Pick what the scoreline will be for the stated period. Other covers every scoreline that isn’t listed.

marketType.name: Correct Score - 1H
marketType.explainer: Pick the exact scoreline at half time, always shown home-away. 'Other' covers every scoreline that isn't listed.

marketType.name: Correct Score - 2H
marketType.explainer: Pick the exact scoreline of the second half only, always shown home-away. 'Other' covers every scoreline that isn't listed. The score resets to 0-0 at half time.

marketType.name: Double Chance and Both Teams To Score - FT
marketType.displayName: Double Chance and Both Teams To Score | Full Time
marketType.explainer: Pick a double chance result and whether both teams score. Both parts must be right for the bet to win. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Multiscores - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick a group of scorelines in one bet - for example 1-0, 2-0 or 3-0. 'Other Home Win' and 'Other Away Win' cover any winning score not listed. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Clean Sheet Home Team - FT
marketType.explainer: Will the home team stop the away team scoring? Pick Yes or No. Based on 90 min + injury time - a 0-0 draw counts as Yes.

marketType.name: Clean Sheet Away Team - FT
marketType.explainer: Will the away team stop the home team scoring? Pick Yes or No. Based on 90 min + injury time - a 0-0 draw counts as Yes.

marketType.name: Total Goals Exact - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick exactly how many goals will be scored during the stated period. Betting on 2 covers 2-0, 1-1 and 0-2.

marketType.name: Odd / Even - FT
marketType.explainer: Will the total goals scored in the match be an odd or even number? 0 counts as even. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Odd / Even - 1H
marketType.explainer: Will the total score in the first half be an odd or even number? 0 counts as even.

marketType.name: Odd / Even - 2H
marketType.explainer: Will the total score in the second half be an odd or even number? 0 counts as even.

marketType.name: Odd / Even - FT- Home Team
marketType.explainer: Pick whether the number of goals scored during the stated period will be Odd or Even. 0 is considered Even.

marketType.name: Odd / Even - FT - Away Team
marketType.explainer: Pick whether the number of goals scored during the stated period will be Odd or Even. 0 is considered Even.

marketType.name: Team To Score Last (3 way)
marketType.explainer: Pick which team will score the match’s last goal, or if there will be no goals. Normal time unless stated otherwise.

marketType.name: Team To Score (4 way) - FT
marketType.explainer: Which teams will score? Pick 'No Goal', 'Home', 'Away' or 'Both'. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Double Chance - 1H
marketType.explainer: One bet covering two results in the first half: 1X (home ahead or level), X2 (level or away ahead) or 12 (either team ahead). Only first-half goals count.

marketType.name: Double Chance - 2H
marketType.explainer: One bet covering two results in the second half: 1X (home ahead or level), X2 (level or away ahead) or 12 (either team ahead). Only second-half goals count.

marketType.name: Both Teams To Score - 1H
marketType.displayName: Both Teams To Score | First Half
marketType.explainer: Will both teams score at least one goal in the first half? Pick Yes or No.

marketType.name: Both Teams To Score - 2H
marketType.displayName: Both Teams To Score | Second Half
marketType.explainer: Will both teams score at least one goal in the second half? Pick Yes or No. First-half goals don't count.

marketType.name: Score in both halves Home - FT
marketType.explainer: Will the home team score in both halves? Pick Yes or No. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Score in both halves Away - FT
marketType.explainer: Will the away team score in both halves? Pick Yes or No. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Both halves win Home - FT
marketType.explainer: Will the home team score more goals than their opponent in both the first and second half? Pick Yes or No. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Both halves win Away - FT
marketType.explainer: Will the away team score more goals than their opponent in both the first and second half? Pick Yes or No. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: 1X2 and Both Teams To Score - FT
marketType.displayName: 1X2 and Both Teams To Score | Full Time
marketType.explainer: Pick the match result and whether both teams score (Yes or No). Both parts must be right for the bet to win. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Double Chance and Totals - FT
marketType.displayName: Double Chance and Over/Under | Full Time
marketType.explainer: Pick a double chance result and whether total goals are over or under the number shown. Both parts must be right for the bet to win. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Win to Nil Home Team - FT
marketType.explainer: Will a team win during the stated period without conceding any goals? Pick either Yes or No.

marketType.name: Win to Nil Away Team - FT
marketType.explainer: Will a team win during the stated period without conceding any goals? Pick either Yes or No.

marketType.name: Total Goals Exact - FT - Home Team
marketType.explainer: Pick exactly how many goals will be scored by the specified team during the stated period.

marketType.name: Total Goals Exact - FT - Away Team
marketType.explainer: Pick exactly how many goals will be scored by the specified team during the stated period.

marketType.name: Double Chance and Both Teams To Score - 1H
marketType.displayName: Double Chance and Both Teams To Score | First Half
marketType.explainer: Pick a double chance result for the first half and whether both teams score in the first half. Both parts must be right for the bet to win.

marketType.name: Double Chance and Both Teams To Score - 2H
marketType.displayName: Double Chance and Both Teams To Score | Second Half
marketType.explainer: Pick a double chance result for the second half and whether both teams score in the second half. Both parts must be right for the bet to win.

marketType.name: Half More Goals - Home Team
marketType.explainer: Pick which half the home team scores more goals in: 'First Half', 'Second Half' or 'Equal'.

marketType.name: Half More Goals - Away Team
marketType.explainer: Pick which half the away team scores more goals in: 'First Half', 'Second Half' or 'Equal'.

marketType.name: Winning Margin - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick how many goals the winning team wins by - for example 'Home by 1' or 'Away by 3+'. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: HT/FT Correct Score - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick the exact scoreline at half time and at the end of the match. Both must be right for the bet to win. Based on Normal time only.

marketType.name: Multigoals - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick the range the total number of goals will fall into. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Multigoals - FT - Home Team
marketType.explainer: Pick the range the home team's goal count will fall into. Based on normal time only.

marketType.name: Multigoals - FT - Away Team
marketType.explainer: Pick the range the away team's goal count will fall into. Based on normal time only.
